slides.headline: Archer plans South Florida air taxis
slides.body: Archer announced South Florida as its 4th planned air taxi network on Dec. 3, 2025, with 10 to 20-minute flights planned between Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Boca Raton and West Palm Beach.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons Miami skyline Biscayne Bay eVTOL air taxi
photo.prompt: electric eVTOL air taxi flying over Biscayne Bay toward downtown Miami, realistic news photo style

slides.headline: That uses Midnight, a 4-passenger electric aircraft
slides.body: Midnight takes off and lands vertically like a helicopter, then flies like a plane with 1 pilot and 4 passengers at about 150 mph.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons electric vertical takeoff aircraft eVTOL Miami
photo.prompt: Archer-style electric air taxi with tilting rotors above Miami, no passengers visible, realistic news photo style

slides.headline: And the landing map includes airports and local pads
slides.body: Planned vertiports include MIA, Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood, Palm Beach International, Hard Rock Stadium, Magic City in Little Haiti, downtown West Palm Beach and Apogee Golf Club.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons Hard Rock Stadium aerial helipad Miami Gardens
photo.prompt: electric eVTOL air taxi landing on a stadium helipad at Hard Rock Stadium in Miami Gardens, realistic news photo style

slides.headline: That also puts West Palm about 30 minutes away
slides.body: Reported trips include Miami to Fort Lauderdale in about 10 minutes by air, and Miami to West Palm Beach in about 30 minutes by air versus 60 to 90 minutes by car.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons I-95 traffic Miami Fort Lauderdale aerial
photo.prompt: electric air taxi flying above I-95 traffic between Miami and Fort Lauderdale, realistic news photo style

slides.headline: And the launch price is about $200 a seat
slides.body: The projected launch fare is around $200 per person, compared with premium ride-share or Uber Black, with prices expected to drop as networks scale.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons Fort Lauderdale beach aerial skyline eVTOL
photo.prompt: electric eVTOL air taxi flying over Fort Lauderdale beach and nearby skyline, no beach crowds visible, realistic news photo style

slides.headline: So Miami passengers are expected around 2027
slides.body: Archer closed Phase 3 of the FAA's 4-phase type certification in May 2026, and Miami passenger service is expected around 2027 after approvals.
